chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Chapter 352: The Daofather's Choice - Ji Ning Loses?
chapter_meta_description: Crimsonbright Daofather names his disciple at the Immortal Fortunes Assembly. Ji Ning faces his greatest test yet, not of his sword, but of his Dao-heart. A new political order is born.
og_title: The Daofather Picks His New Favorite!
og_description: Ji Ning gives it his all, but the Dao of fate has other plans. See how our protagonist handles the cruelest loss of his cultivation journey.
twitter_description: When a Daofather chooses, raw power isn't enough. Ji Ning's spirit is tested as an unexpected winner takes the prize.

lore_anchors.definition: In the Desolate Era universe, a Daofather is a supreme being of the Three Realms, the pinnacle of Ki Refining (Ancestral Immortal) who has mastered a Heavenly Dao. They are the true rulers of reality, superior even to Celestial Immortals and Pure Yang True Immortals.

A True Immortal who has refined all the yin energy from their soul and body, achieving a state of pure yang. They are immensely powerful beings in the Three Realms, well beyond ordinary Celestial Immortals.
A second body cultivated by a powerful Ki Refiner, formed from their Primal soul. It functions as an independent clone and allows a cultivator to be in two places at once.
The known universe of the novel's first major arc, consisting of the Heaven Realm, the Mortal Realm, and the Netherworld Kingdom.

A catastrophic state of spiritual backlash in Xianxia cultivation. When a cultivator's mental state is shattered (by shock, grief, or rage), their internal energy becomes chaotic, often leading to death or transformation into a mindless demon.
A great power of the Three Realms, often associated with the Black Tortoise, one of the Four Symbols of Chinese constellations. He is a master of water and defensive mysteries.
